body: Accepted without objection. `controllerEpoch` belongs only to PlaybackControlLease command authorization and cannot invalidate cards, capture, or publication. LIVE_VERIFIED visibility binds to `{presentationSessionEpoch, publicSlideOccurrence, publicationPolicyVersion, cardVersion}` plus stream liveness/local expiry. It invalidates on presentation end/rebind, slide occurrence mismatch, tombstone/retract/expiry, policy-rights-DLP-source invalidation, incompatible card/schema cohort, or PublicCardStream disconnect—not ordinary playback takeover. Candidate approval performs current PublicationAuthority capability check plus causal-envelope CAS at commit time. If the approving actor loses publish capability before CAS, reject; an already committed card remains governed by its publication lease and later tombstones/policy invalidation.
